titles.title: ศึกมหาเวทโดซา

description:
“In the year 2025, the Year of the Blue Snake, the Korean Peninsula shall reach a momentous turning point that decides the ultimate fate of the nation.”

 A lost prophecy recovered from a torn page of the ancient Jeonggamnok.

As the fateful year arrives, shadows lengthen over modern Korea. Secret orders of Taoist sorcerers emerge from the fringes of history, dividing into two fierce factions. On one side stand the Visionaries, determined to trigger catastrophic events to fulfill the grand prophecy and usher in a new era at any cost. On the other stand the Guardians, modern practitioners bound by ancient oath to prevent the predicted ruin and shield the realm. Behind high-tech skyscrapers and bustling city streets, an invisible, high-stakes war erupts—where ancient talismans, celestial martial arts, and elemental magic collide to decide the destiny of a nation.
